maya: Heads up — noticed weird decode hiccups on canary with AWQ + act-quant enabled. Small fraction of requests return truncated generations or repeated tokens.
dan: Where are you seeing it? logs/console or user reports? :eyes:
maya: Both. User repro on staging (long chat session, many prefix tokens). Logs show repeated 'kv-cache-miss' and a few streams stuck at EOF.
sasha: Can you paste the AWQ config used for the canary?
maya: Sure — deployed canary with these overrides:
```
model: gptx-7b-awq
quant: awq_actq
group_size: 128
act_quant: true
batch_latency_target_ms: 60
kv_cache: on
```
leila: Interesting. We usually use group_size 64 in prod for that model. 128 might cause larger intermediate buffers and trigger path that does not flush KV on some edge sequences.
ryan: Did you try disabling act_quant? that was flaky last month for longer sequences.
maya: I tried locally: group_size 128 + act_quant off = fewer truncations but throughput down ~6%. group_size 64 + act_quant on = seems stable so far (12h run).
dan: Any GPU OOM logs or hourglass stalls in runtime?
maya: No OOMs. Runtime logs show repeated: `serve/runtime: flush_kv failed: partial_write` a few times around the stuck sessions.
sasha: Could be an alignment bug in the AWQ kernel when act_quant is enabled with non-power-of-two group alignment. We saw something similar with custom kernel in 2024.
leila: Quick mitigation: roll canary back to g64-actq or use awq_noactq_g128 variant?
ryan: I recommend a controlled experiment matrix: group_size in [32,64,128], act_quant [on, off], and heavy long-session load. Record: truncation_rate, repeat_token_rate, p95 latency, token/sec.
maya: I'll run a 6h sweep on staging with that matrix. setting up runs now.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout triggered: 2 instances -> 0.1 traffic to canary (id: canary-176850) :rocket:
dan: If you have a quick repro script, drop it here so infra can replay at scale.
maya: Repro script: `scripts/repro_long_chat.py --turns 80 --prefix_len 1024 --concurrency 40` — will attach after runs.
sasha: If problem reproduces, collect nvprof traces and kernel logs. Also capture the exact model binary sha.
maya: Will do. First pass results (2h in): g128+actq: truncation 0.9% and spikes at 2.2k tok/s. g64+actq: truncation 0.03%. g128+noactq: truncation 0.15%.
leila: That suggests act_quant exacerbates the issue at g128. Could be numerical overflow in the activation quant path under specific packing.
ryan: For safety, can we add an automatic fallback rule in routing: if truncation_rate > 0.5% then route to variant g64? That can limit user impact.
maya: I'll add A/B rule to the canary config.
dan: Thanks. If your 6h sweep shows reproducible failure we'll open a bug and tag runtime/kernel. Keep short logs and model sha so we can bisect. :bug:
maya: Copy — will upload logs + nvprof + model sha to the thread when done. :thumbsup:
